newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs propelled upward by close, but well-off highs.
newsitem.headline: JGBs propelled upward by close, but well-off highs.

text.p: *June JGB propelled higher on short-covering by close, but well-off highs as it shed some gains on large-lot speculative selling towards close.
*June broke, though temporarily, key resistance of 126.88.
*Postponement of jumbo corporate bonds added to upbeat mood.
